$comment: The ungrouped index (groupByCategory false: "the index list alone") is a recorded gap: collection-showcase.json draws the list inside a non-optional div.salt-showcase__group with a required group heading, so the checker has no form for a bare list. Likewise the grouped form's unheaded leading list of uncategorised entries cannot be matched, so every post here has a category. Items carry categories as [{ title }], the same shape as tags.
summary: Posts in the index layout, grouped under their categories: one group per category, each with a heading (body base + 1) and a list of links.
